family.description: This domain is found in PilZ domain-containing proteins from Deltaproteobacteria, such as swiss:Q748G9 from Geobacter sulfurreducens. This domain is located N-terminal to a canonical PilZ domain, with a PilZ-related structure comprising the beta-barrel fold, lacking the C-terminal alpha-helix and both c-d-GMP-binding motifs [[cite:PUB00098203]]. This domain also has a N-terminal loop that forms a short alpha-helix (3 residues) [[cite:PUB00098203]].
family.name: N-terminal PilZ-like domain PilZN1
